subject: Outcome Lattice: evaluation success lanes & acceptance tests
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily@healthlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Outcome Lattice: evaluation success lanes & acceptance tests

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the product walkthrough last week — the team found the latency/cost model really compelling. Jordan and I sketched a short MAP to get to a decision by October. Before we lock dates, wanted to share a first-pass of how HealthLytics views success for the eval. I attached a "Outcome-Lattice" worksheet that splits acceptance into three lanes (Functional, Performance, Ops).

High level asks from our side: 
- Can Redwood provide a compact acceptance test suite (10–12 smoke scenarios) with pass/fail thresholds we can run in our staging?
- We need explicit rollback/stop conditions tied to accuracy regressions and end-to-end latency percentiles.
- A checklist for data handling (KV-cache, retention, logs) so our security/compliance team can sign off.

Proposed timeline: kickoff next week, two-week integration + smoke run, then a production-like throughput test. Decision meeting on Oct 2.

Attachments: Outcome-Lattice-v1.xlsx (Excel, 38KB)

Appreciate your quick thoughts — Jordan and I are flexible on the structure, but we want clearly measurable gates.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of ML Platforms, HealthLytics
emily@healthlytics.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthlytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outcome Lattice: evaluation success lanes & acceptance tests

Hi Emily — thanks for the lattice doc and the clear asks. Attaching a short MAP draft (MAP-draft.pdf) that maps your lanes to our acceptance tests and runbook. Key notes inline below; see the attachment for the checklist and test definitions.

Quick summary of proposed acceptance lanes (what we'll measure):
1) Functional correctness (accuracy lanes)
   - Test set: 500 domain queries + 50 adversarial prompts.
   - Acceptance: mean normalized score >= 0.88 and no more than 5% critical misclassifications.
2) Performance (latency & throughput)
   - Smoke: p95 < 450ms for single-user 2K token flows.
   - Throughput stress: sustained 200 rps with median latency < 350ms and p99 < 750ms.
3) Ops & security
   - KV cache retention validated (no leakage) and audit log entries present for every request.
   - SOC-like checklist: encryption at rest, customer-managed KMS confirmed.

Exit/stop gates (examples):
- Immediate stop: any run showing >8% critical misclassifications on the target test set.
- Rollback trigger: sustained p99 latency > 900ms during throughput run.

Run plan (high level):
- Week 1: account onboarding, infra checklist, minimal integration test (1–2 days).
- Week 2: smoke scenarios (two days), iterate on prompt templates and prompt-engineering hooks.
- Week 3: throughput/stability run (one day) + post-run evaluation.

I also added three representative smoke scenarios in the PDF with expected outputs and scoring rules. We can flex on sizes; want to make sure your security team has the audit artifacts they need.

Attachments: MAP-draft.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Would Karthik be able to join the kickoff to walk through the stress test configuration?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily@healthlytics.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outcome Lattice: evaluation success lanes & acceptance tests

Thanks for looping me in — happy to run the throughput/stability run and own the stress harness. A few operational clarifications so we can finalize the MAP: 

Operational details we need from HealthLytics:
- Target concurrency profile (typical session length in tokens, number of concurrent sessions).
- A representative sample dataset for the 500-query functional set (can be redacted examples).
- Which telemetry level your security team requires (full request/response payloads vs. hashed fingerprints).

Our testing deliverables:
- Smoke harness (runnable in your VPC using our agent) with explicit scoring script (we'll provide a Docker image).
- A short regression report with: pass/fail per scenario, latency histograms, KV-cache hit-rate, and a list of any safety/ hallucination incidents.

Proposed kickoff: Thursday 28 Aug, 10:00–11:00 PT. I'll cover the stress-run config and the runbook; Mina will cover contract/activation gating.

If that works for you, Mina — I'll send a calendar invite and link to the stress-run repo.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Emily Zhang <emily@healthlytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 Aug 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Outcome Lattice: evaluation success lanes & acceptance tests

Perfect — Thursday 10am PT works. We'll provide the redacted dataset and the target concurrency profile before the kickoff (expect to upload to the Drive link). Couple of comments from Jordan (cc'd earlier) that I noted in the lattice: please add a short acceptance criterion for "semantic stability" (no more than 10% drift between smoke and throughput runs on the key metric). Otherwise this looks actionable.

See you Thursday — Emily
